{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Concussion}}
A '''concussion bomb''' was a weapon that could be employed by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as an offensive weapon, and contained an armor-piercing warhead with a small energy pack. Upon detonation, concussion bombs generated a powerful concussive blast which damaged the surrounding area, and also disrupted instrumentation and equipment.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
